effects.text: You become Invisible for 1 minute or until you attack or use an ability.

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

1 Action (1 scrap): You become Invisible for 1 minute or until you attack or use an ability.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): You are Hidden as if succeeding a Stealth (DEX) check.

Passive: You are Invisible while in smoke, mist, fog, or other gases.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Mist Cloak (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Mist Cloak" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Give yourself Invisible; remove it when you attack or use an ability.
